text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while Sweep Tosho and I are
preparing
for the Tiara tour...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Enough yapping. When I say "let's go," then let's go! Hurry up and get ready! Faster!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho grabs me, and before I
know it, I've
been tugged all the way to
the art museum.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Did you know that looking at
pictures
counts as studying?
choice_data_list: 『ティアラを彩る可憐な走り』展？
choice_data_list_en: 'The Graceful Runs that Adorn the Tiara' exhibition?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grandma told me that only Umamusume who really know racing can use racing magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What're you covering your mouth for?
choice_data_list: （そのために自分でリサーチして……！？）
choice_data_list_en: (She did her own research just for that...?!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're just so happy that I invited you to
come
out with me? Wow. You're like a
little kid.
choice_data_list: いや、嬉しいなと思って……！
ううん、嬉しいなと思って……！
choice_data_list_en: No, I was just thinking how happy I am...!
No, I was just thinking how happy I am...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But we're not here for fun! This is about
learning!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Got it? Now follow me, Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Staff
text_block_list.text:
Two guests? May I have your tickets,
please?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Familiar!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho and I enter the exhibit and
take in
the photos of Tiara tour
contenders.
choice_data_list: チケットを大人1人、学生1人分ください！
choice_data_list_en: One adult and one student ticket, please!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hm... Oka Sho... Oka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There it is! And the year my great
grandma ran
waaas...

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's Air Groove in the Japanese
Oaks! I really
love the way she runs.

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
There are pictures of Hishi Amazon's
races over
here! Man, was she tough
back then.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm. Hishiama and Air Groove are
pretty
famous, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Here's a picture of the two of them.
Hmmm...
They do make quite an
impression.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove and Hishi Amazon created
quite a
frenzy in their heyday. There are
a number of
photos of them here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're both as graceful as flowers, yet
with
overwhelming presences. I find
myself holding my
breath just looking at
their photos.

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but Hishi Amazon couldn't pull it
off in the
end. Narita Brian ended up
beating her in the
Arima Kinen,
remember?

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't much she could've done
about that.
She was up against a Classic
Triple Crown
champion.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, lady! What's that supposed to
mean?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean she couldn't have
done
anything about it? Have you
forgotten how
strong Hishiama was?

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
I guess she was pretty good. But that's
just the
way things are.

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Racers who run in the Triple Tiara tour
just can't
hold a candle to those who
compete in the Triple
Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Seriously?

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
I get that. It's like the ones who make it
through
the Classic Triple Crown tour
have escaped the
jaws of death.

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
I was cheering for Fine Motion in the
Arima
Kinen, but that Symboli Kris S was
just too good.
Fine Motion didn't stand
a chance.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
She didn't stand a chance? Because she
went for
the Triple Tiara tour, and Kris S
ran in the Classic
Triple Crown tour?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's why she didn't stand a chance?

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor A
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but Air Groove did have potential,
don't you
think? I mean, she won the
autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
But then she lost the Arima Kinen to
someone
from the Classic Triple Crown
tour—one who
didn't even win a single
race.

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
Her winning the fall Tenno was a pretty
big deal,
sure. But that's the only race
she won in her senior
year. C'mon, you
can't deny the pattern.

text_block_list.name: Exhibit Visitor C
text_block_list.text:
History's proven it to be true. The title
of "the
strongest" is reserved specifically
for Umamusume
who have seized victory
in the Classic Triple
Crown tour!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The aptitude and abilities you need to
run in the
Classic Triple Crown tour
versus the Triple Tiara
tour are
fundamentally different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why it's impossible to say
categorically that
one of the tours is
better than the other. That
said...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown has a long
history as
Japan's first Triple Crown
series. The races are
also different
lengths, and competitors have to
be
able to adapt to them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And the other visitors said, Triple Crown
tour
runners are stronger than Tiara tour
runners...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At least, according to the abundance of
discourse
and race results suggesting
they are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in the midst of all this, Sweep
Tosho...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Like... really?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Reeeaaally?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's so stuuuuupid!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, she runs out of the
exhibit and
back to my office, where she
begins poring over
documents at a
blistering speed!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sweep! I put the materials about the
Triple Tiara
tour you asked about over
here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Rob Roy! Don't just stand there,
Familiar!
Hurry up and hand them to me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you hear what they said?! Don't
you think
all that stuff they were saying
was so dumb?!
choice_data_list: わ、わかった……けどどうしたんだ？
わ、わかった……けどどうしたの？
choice_data_list_en: A-All right... but what's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh... Here! This too! Look at this article!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hands me an article with the
headline:
"Autumn Tenno Sho Upset:
Triple Tiara
Umamusume Manages First
Victory in 17 Years."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's weird, right?! "Manages"? "Upset"?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... I think they're just saying that
Air
Groove's accomplishment was really
amazing
because it's so rare in terms of
history.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but calling it an "upset" and
saying she
"managed" to win is an
awfully weird way to
praise someone!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's like saying it's practically a
miracle she
didn't lose!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aaagh! Seriously, what the heck?! It's
stupid! It's
dumb! It's so laaaaame!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Who cares if someone's from the Classic
Triple
Crown tour or the Triple Tiara
tour?! It's got
nothing to do with
anything!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Strength is strength! That's all that
matters!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But everyone talks like people on the Classic Triple Crown tour are obviously better than everyone else! Like it's just the way things are!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: They just go on and on and on and on about it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I don't care about history or proof of
whatever!
It's LAAAAAME!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...That's it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Familiar. I'm gonna use racing
magic.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It'll change everything! I'm gonna smash
this way
of thinking to pieces and wake
everyone up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter if you run the Triple
Crown tour
or the Tiara tour! Strength is
strength! And
everyone needs to know
that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll show everyone with my very own
magic—my
racing magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Because magic... Well...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Magic can turn everything around! It can
change
everything!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I know it can!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Got that, Familiar?! I'm not taking "no"
for an
answer!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna find that magic no matter
what! First,
I'm gonna search for it, then
I'm gonna find it and
use it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna change the world with my very
own
racing magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And you're gonna help me! Got it?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This small witch has ambition tenfold the
size of
her stature. And while her dream
sounds more like
a fairy tale...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: We definitely, definitely will!
choice_data_list: わかった。絶対にやりとげよう！
choice_data_list_en: Understood. Let's see this through no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod with as much fervor as my neck can
offer. I
know we'll pull this off. After all,
the magic
started the second she made
up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sweep Tosho begins her long
and
arduous journey to find the magic
that will
change the world.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Wow.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Sweep... You're amazing...
